verdict.rationale: Anytype officially ships native iOS and Android apps (not just companions) [anytype-docs-54], and community users confirm the apps 'work well' with cross-device sync [anytype-comm-3][anytype-comm-9]. However, the evidence never confirms feature parity for mobile on power-user capabilities like Queries, Graph view, custom Types, or API/agent integrations, and one user describes using it only 'as a very basic note system' on mobile, with UI issues noted (tiny type on iPad Mini) [anytype-comm-1][anytype-comm-3]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of mobile support for advanced organize features (Queries, Graph, Templates, Types) and any mention of local API/MCP/CLI availability on mobile, plus independent verification of full search/linking parity on mobile.
